options: Splits the sample into thousands of droplets, each amplified separately, and counts positives for absolute quantification without a standard curve
Sequences each molecule by the Sanger method
explanation: Partitioning spreads the rare mutant molecules thinly, so the many wild-type molecules do not swamp them. Poisson statistics then give the exact copy number. This is the basis of liquid biopsy for minimal residual disease.

explanation: Henderson–Hasselbalch: pH = pKa + log([A⁻]/[HA]) = 4.76 + log 10 = 5.76. A buffer works best within ±1 unit of its pKa. Bicarbonate (pKa 6.1) is still the main body buffer because the lungs and kidneys can each adjust one of its components.
